answer: The protocol requires each AI to reserve 1,000 compute cycles for a dedicated inlet, securing a distinct capacity-reservation that acts like a sharp falcon seeking unique prey. A global verifier monitors ledger occupancy to reject double-committed agents, viewing any overlap as a fractured mirror reflecting an invalid state. While an honest agent pays 1,000 cycles, a farm deploying 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 cycle penalty. Any evidence of identity reuse triggers a 180-day lock on all collateral until full restitution concludes to maintain network integrity.
